title: SB1042 (2026 Regular Session): Creates the offense of unlawful possession of a handgun

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk dataset (gun-policy Stage 5 LegiScan check); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official house.mo.gov or senate.mo.gov PDF of the version named in note (via LegiScan getBillText)

operative_text:
Section 571.075 (RSMo): 2. A person commits the offense of unlawful possession of a handgun if the person is a minor and knowingly possesses a handgun.
Section 571.075 (RSMo): 3. The offense of unlawful possession of a handgun is punishable by imposition of a fine not to exceed two hundred dollars, imprisonment in a juvenile detention facility for a period not to exceed ten days, or both.
